CustomField.description: API name of the hierarchy Custom Setting whose boolean flags the anonymization raises for the running user during a run (automation bypass). Blank = the standard TEKCO_BypassSettings__c. Only read when TEKCO_BypassEnabled__c is true. Lets an org that has its own bypass setting (e.g. Portugal) suppress triggers/flows/validation rules during anonymization instead of paying their cost on every update.
CustomField.label: Bypass Object API Name
